title: Importing Peer Review Mechanisms: Multi-Reviewer Oversight With Conflict Resolution

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Multi-reviewer systems could improve oversight quality by catching individual errors. Plausible chain but the mechanism (ensemble of weak overseers) is already somewhat explored in ML. The peer review framing adds limited novelty to the safety insight.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running multiple model overseers, implementing a conflict resolution mechanism, and comparing to single-overseer baseline. Multiple components but each is individually simple. Moderate for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multi-overseer system plus meta-reviewer plus comparison to baseline. Three components to implement. Feasible if kept simple but not tightly scoped for 30 hours.
